svg.title: Conflicting pointing hands surround Cecil as one resident has three official identities.
svg.desc: Several residents point along different but workable routes while Cecil stands at their centre. Riju records each route, and three official messengers approach the same person at the shared landmark.
svg.text: Page 8, panel 5 · Wide overhead-oblique shot of a lane junction and competing directions

text.tspan: Residents supply different accurate routes as Cecil
finds three digital identities at the destination.

svg.text: CONTEXTUAL PRODUCTION PLACEHOLDER — ART NOT PUBLIC
